solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: I'd pass him stumbling towards centre of vessel …

indicators.note: someone stumbling moves clumsily and out of order, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A person told to let a man go by trips while heading for the middle of a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stumbling' rearranges the nine letters of I'D PASS HIM.
explanation.definitionFit: Midships is the middle part of a vessel, so the adverb means towards or in that central region.

clue.text: Thomas rises to give a few words

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters are read upwards, back to front

parts.note: Tom is the short form of the name Thomas
taken as written

explanation.surface: Thomas stands up to say something brief.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rises' means reading upwards, so the name is turned before the plain 'to' follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A motto is a short saying or phrase, literally a few words expressing a principle.

clue.text: One in the car club

definitions.meaning: the person at the wheel of a motor vehicle
a golf club used for long tee shots, the number one wood

explanation.definitionFit: The motorist steering is the one behind the wheel, and the long-hitting golf wood shares that name.

clue.text: The man taking Ecstasy may produce animal sound

parts.note: he is the pronoun for the man
E is slang for the drug Ecstasy
may is the hawthorn, whose fruit or tree is also called the haw

explanation.surface: A man on drugs might start braying like a beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may' looks like a verb but is the hawthorn, also called the haw; 'produce' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry of a donkey is a bray, written imitatively as two syllables.

clue.text: After a bit of Italian food

parts.note: past means after, as in half past three

explanation.surface: Following a portion of something to eat in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Spaghetti, penne and the like are classic Italian foods made of dough, and a helping is a bit of that cuisine.

clue.text: Cheated and voted twice?

definitions.meaning: betrayed someone by pretending to work with them
having put two marks on a ballot paper, each an X

explanation.definitionFit: Betraying an ally is an idiom of treachery, while the whimsical second reading is two ballot marks.

clue.text: Changing one's mind about leaving

parts.note: seems to describe deciding not to depart, but means altering a will so an heir gets no bequest

explanation.surface: Someone has second thoughts about walking out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' is not departing but leaving property in a will.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting an heir out of a will is a change of mind about what one leaves to them as a legacy.

clue.text: . . vessel from Orient with spinach being transported

indicators.note: goods being transported are moved about, so these letters are carried into a new order

explanation.surface: A ship arrives from the East laden with leafy vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being transported' rearranges ORIENT and SPINACH together; the leading dots continue the previous clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A container ship is a cargo vessel built to carry standard freight boxes.

clue.text: Heap of cattle to keep in reserve?

parts.note: farm animals are livestock, or stock
a pile is a heap

explanation.surface: A farmer keeps a mound of cows back for later.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads 'pile of stock', so the pieces swap order; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To stockpile is to accumulate supplies and hold them for future use, keeping a reserve.

clue.text: Motormen with energy adjusted timer

indicators.note: something adjusted is altered and rearranged, so these letters are shifted

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Train drivers with some vim fine-tune a clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjusted' rearranges MOTORMEN plus E.
explanation.definitionFit: A metronome is a device musicians use to keep time, ticking at a set pace.

clue.text: Proscribed cricketer returned with pair

indicators.note: something returned goes back the way it came, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a bat is a batsman in cricket
in cricket a pair is two ducks, two scores of nought, written as two Os

explanation.surface: A banned cricket player comes back with two partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns BAT into TAB; a pair in cricket is out for nought in both innings.
explanation.definitionFit: Something taboo is forbidden by custom, just as a proscribed thing is banned.

clue.text: Quick breathing

definitions.meaning: living, an old sense kept in 'the quick and the dead'

explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe the state of being alive, one in its archaic biblical sense of living.

clue.text: Baron ate uncooked meat

indicators.note: the outer letters take in the others, as if swallowing and eating them

parts.note: Bn is the abbreviation for Baron
uncooked food is raw

explanation.surface: A nobleman eats raw flesh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ate' looks like part of the story of a nobleman dining, but it signals one piece swallowing another.
explanation.definitionFit: Brawn is a jellied meat made from a pig's head, also called head cheese.

clue.text: Signal — possible epidemic emerging

indicators.note: the letters emerge from inside the words, appearing across their join

explanation.surface: A warning that an outbreak of disease may be appearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'emerging' finds the letters across 'possiBLE EPidemic'.
explanation.definitionFit: A bleep is a short electronic tone sent as an alert or signal.

clue.text: Said fortune-teller's boring tool

indicators.note: words that are said are spoken, so the clue word is replaced by one sounding alike

parts.note: an augur is a soothsayer who predicts the future

explanation.surface: Apparently a clairvoyant's dull instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Said' calls for a word sounding like AUGUR, a prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: An auger is a drill for making holes, boring being the act of drilling.

clue.text: a couple of tenors in The Big Apple are ingenious

indicators.note: placed inside, so one set of letters sits within the other

parts.note: the Big Apple is New York, NY
T is an abbreviation for tenor, so two of them give TT

explanation.surface: Two operatic singers performing in New York are clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the containment signal; 'are' is just a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Natty can mean deft or cleverly contrived as well as smartly dressed, so it suits ingenious.

clue.text: To do with set of principles Ruby found in California

definitions.text: To do with set of principles

indicators.note: one set of letters is found inside the other

parts.note: ruby is a shade of red

explanation.surface: A jewel discovered in the American west relates to a code of belief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found in' signals the gemstone colour going inside the state's short name.
explanation.definitionFit: A creed is a set of principles, and the adjective relating to a creed describes such things.

clue.text: Beast didn't start to find pollen in it

indicators.note: something that doesn't start is missing its beginning, so the opening letter goes

parts.note: a panther is a wild beast, a big cat

explanation.surface: A wild cat lost its nerve before going in search of plant dust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'didn't start' removes the first letter from PANTHER; 'to find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The anther is the part of a flower's stamen that holds pollen.

clue.text: Dozen removed from the score

parts.note: seems to be about a match result, but a score is twenty and a dozen twelve, so the sum is a subtraction

explanation.surface: A dozen points were taken off the match result.
explanation.walkthrough: A score is twenty; taking away twelve leaves the number defined.
explanation.definitionFit: Twenty minus twelve is arithmetic giving the number between seven and nine.

clue.text: Read that which reportedly belongs to the country

indicators.note: what is reported is spoken, so the phrase is replaced by words sounding alike

parts.note: a thing belonging to the South American country is Peru's

explanation.surface: Study whatever is said to be national property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' gives the sound of PERU'S, as in something that belongs to Peru; 'that which' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read something, traditionally carefully and thoroughly.

clue.text: Another going round, not round capital

indicators.note: letters going round are spun into a new order
not means the following letter is left out

parts.note: a round thing is O, the circular letter

explanation.surface: Yet another one circling, but not circling, a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes O from ANOTHER, and 'going round' rearranges the remaining ANTHER.
explanation.definitionFit: Tehran is the capital city of Iran.

clue.text: Bright getting bonus, quantity yet to be ascertained

parts.note: a perk is a bonus or extra benefit
in algebra Y is an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: A cheerful worker receives an extra of uncertain size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is a link; X, Y and Z are algebra's unknowns.
explanation.definitionFit: Perky means lively and cheerful, as does bright when describing a mood.

clue.text: Was brown model still in existence?

parts.note: ex means former, what something was
tan is a light brown
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: Was the sun-tanned fashion model still around?
explanation.walkthrough: The Model T Ford gives T for model.
explanation.definitionFit: Extant means surviving to the present, used of documents or species that have not been lost.

clue.text: Starts to kick under new goalposts, endless fun in martial art

indicators.note: the starts of these words are their first letters
without an end, so the final letter goes

explanation.surface: Kicking beneath new goalposts, a sport with unbroken fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starts to' takes the first letters of kick, under, new, goalposts; 'endless' trims fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Kung fu is the Chinese system of unarmed combat, a martial art.

clue.text: The Spanish and South African tropical fever

parts.note: las is a Spanish word for the, feminine plural
SA is short for South Africa

explanation.surface: Spain and South Africa share a disease of hot countries.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassa fever is a viral haemorrhagic disease of West Africa, named after a Nigerian town.

clue.text: Halls used when a legal process has been curtailed

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short at the tail, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a trial is a legal process in court

explanation.surface: Courtrooms are used once a case has been stopped early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has been curtailed' cuts the final letter off TRIAL; 'used when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Atria are entrance halls or central courts in a building, plural of atrium.

clue.text: Pole inside grotto temporarily

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the run of words, across their join

explanation.surface: A post was placed in the cave for the time being.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' finds the letters in 'grotTO TEMporarily'.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem pole is a carved post, and the totem itself is the emblem on it.

clue.text: Territorials' military language in southern Asia

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: Reserve soldiers use a tongue spoken in South Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamil is a Dravidian tongue spoken in southern India and Sri Lanka.

clue.text: New order from back row intended to be heard

parts.note: the rear is the back
a range is a row, as of mountains

indicators.note: heard means spoken, so the word is swapped for one sounding the same

parts.note: intended means meant

explanation.surface: Reshuffling the back line was supposed to be noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be heard' gives MENT for MEANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A rearrangement puts things in a different sequence, establishing a fresh order.

clue.text: Cheers to the greatest extent going round court in a diplomatic way

indicators.note: the outer letters go round the others, enclosing them

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, like cheers
fully means completely, to the utmost

explanation.surface: Thanks are given round the royal palace with maximum discretion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going round' signals the thanks-plus-fully pair enclosing the court abbreviation; 'Cheers' is not a toast but British thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with tact means handling people sensitively, which is what diplomacy requires.
